lines.text: Small businesses lose real money in their invoice pile. Duplicates. Price creep. Fake bank details.
Meet Ledgerline: an accounts-payable agent, built this week on Meta's Muse models.
Muse Spark reads every page. Muse Voice Transcribe hears my manager's voice memo. SAM 3.1 counts the coffee sacks: nine, not ten.
A second Muse Spark pass checks every decision against the original, and shows exactly where the evidence is.
This email asks us to pay a new account. The domain is one letter off. Rejected.
Then it stops. Nothing is paid or sent until a human approves.
Need privacy? The same agent runs on Muse Glimmer, right on this laptop.
Thirty-two documents. Twelve problems caught. Over eight thousand euros protected. Ledgerline.
